text: The source that identifies the 2021 loss area as a pine plantation is the Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) National forest cartography version 2021. According to this source, the forest type over the event area consists of planted forest totaling 68.1 hectares, with the planted species being Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. This information is part of the evidence supporting the tree-cover loss claim within the asset in 2021.
